Remarks

This service posts messages to the Twilio Email endpoint (POST /v1/Emails), which processes requests asynchronously and answers with 202 Accepted plus an operation identifier. It supports HTML and plain text content, Base64 attachments, inline images, custom headers, tags, Liquid personalization variables and scheduled delivery. Register it through AddTwilioMail(IServiceCollection, IConfiguration, string, Action<HttpStandardResilienceOptions>?).

Parameters

The identifier of the asynchronous operation created by the API, along with the URL to track it.

Remarks

The returned result means the request was accepted for processing. The delivery status can be tracked through TrackingLocation.
